t: Duckhams 5W-40 fully synthetic engine oil is designed for modern passenger cars, offering advanced protection for high-performance petrol and diesel engines. This formulation uses modern additive technology and high-quality base oils to meet current specifications. It provides core cold-start protection and maintains a strong lubricating film at high operating temperatures, crucial for vehicle maintenance. The advanced formula ensures engine cleanliness, minimises wear, and maximises fuel efficiency for contemporary vehicles. This makes it suitable for mechanics and car enthusiasts seeking reliable engine performance.
